title: List handler still duplicates status_from_string inline (r2 note carried forward)
detail: r2 note carried forward — genuinely unaddressed. The inline case still duplicates shared status_from_string arm-for-arm; only the unknown-warning log differs. Future enum additions stay at drift risk (r1 B1 happened exactly this way).
recommended_fix: Wrap shared status_from_string with an unknown-guard that emits the warning, then call it here — removes the arm-count mismatch surface that caused r1 B1.
